b) Reference: the onion rings are about 6-7 cm across. The bowl spans roughly 3.5 onion-ring lengths across the top... more directly, the bowl's rim fills most of the frame width (about 480 px of a 640 px image). Taking the bowl as about 24 cm wide, the onion rings look about 5-6 cm across, which fits a 22-25 cm bowl.

- Fill: the food sits about 40% of the way down to the rim, so fill ≈ 0.4. Food volume = 4.26 x 0.4 x 0.4 ≈ 0.68 litres = 680 ml.
- Items by share: shredded carrot about 45%, sliced red onion about 35%, shaved hard cheese (Parmesan-style) about 20%.

- Onion: 238 ml x 0.6 = 143 g
